title: Allow custom dissectors for BLE advertisement service UUIDs
description:
Add a dissector table "btcommon.eir_ad.entry.uuid_16", which behaves the same
way as the hard-coded GAEN (Google/Apple Exposure Notification) dissector does
today.

The table key is a lower-case hex-string representing the UUID, which is 4
characters for a 16-bit UUID, and 8 characters for a 32-bit UUID. 128-bit UUID's
representation contains 4 dashes, which makes it 36 characters long. The dissector
is given the corresponding service data.
